_comment: Generated by scripts/error-contract/sync.ts; do not edit. One case per code in keenable-backend-ts docs/error-catalog.json (error format v1: type, code, fix, docs_url and retryable from the catalog; error and message are its title and summary, which a route may word differently, and SDKs never parse them), with the domain extras of the "before v1" case of the same code. The "(before v1)" cases are bodies older servers send, without type; expect.type is what an SDK derives from the status and code. The SDKs do not expose docs_url, billing_url, auto_top_up_url or pay_per_request: each value in expect.absent must appear in neither the error's message nor any of its fields except body and fix, and a 402's message is the SDK's own. Kept identical in go/testdata, python/tests/fixtures and typescript/test/fixtures.
